We offer smart grid solutions across multiple levels: intelligent connected devices, communications networks, data management, enterprise applications and analytics. Learn more at http://www.tantalus.com/. The Opportunity: As a Data Analyst Co-op, you'll work alongside a small, hands-on team maintaining and improving production analytics products that support smart grid operations for utility companies across North America. This is a role for someone who takes pride in clean, well-structured work and wants meaningful exposure to the full analytics development lifecycle. What you will do: • Work with the other members of your team to deliver new features and capabilities in TRUGrid Analytics products. • Maintain and enhance our suite of Tableau dashboards and reports hosted on Tableau Server, including troubleshooting data source issues, optimizing workbook performance, and supporting end users. • Work with the other team members to understand application/feature functionality and testability • Python script cleanup and refactoring - improve code quality, adding documentation and writing unit tests to bring our codebase up to production standards. • Research, track and understand new technologies Support data cleaning, preparation, and validation using PostgreSQL databases. • Job Requirements What you Bring: Education and Experience • Student is enrolled in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics or related disciplines. • Has genuine curiosity about data systems and quality. • Experience with Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server is a strong asset. • Should be comfortable working with SQL, writing queries and have hands on experience with Python in writing maintainable code. • Experience with command line tools in Linux Experience with Python, SQL, git and GitLab, and software development workflow tools is an asset • Personal Attributes Required: • Strong organizational, time management, interpersonal and communication (both written and oral) skills. • Ability to work efficiently, independently, and in a team environment. • Willingness to learn • Ability to think critically and effectively solve problems Strong technical aptitude, with a pragmatic, thoughtful approach to challenging problems • Nice to Have: • Prior exposure to time series data, geospatial data (GIS software) • Experience with git Go (Golang) or similar language such as Java or C++ • Experience with containerization concepts with Docker and Kubernetes • Familiarity with HTML/CSS/Javascript Familiarity working with or developing REST API • N/A Citizenship Requirement APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through UBC Science Co-op Cover Letter Required?
